name: beam-ranking-localization
query: Long-horizon crop plans are undervalued during beam-state ranking because valuation only reflects shops currently unlocked. Locate the production code that computes approximate values used to rank and prune beam-search states, and the tests relevant to that ranking path. The intended change is only to beam-state ranking; candidate admission and final portfolio selection should remain unchanged. Future-shop valuation must preserve the live absolute game day so shop-unlock boundaries are handled correctly.
notes: The oracle is intentionally stored outside tests/fixtures/beam-ranking/repo so FastContext cannot inspect it during the benchmark. A run passes only if both required files appear in the final citations.
